text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmhm… Hmmmhmhmhm…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ack―!! I could see it!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's going to run down the 
Bakushin Road with my overwhelming speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come, now, Trainer, let's get this thing 
going!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
First of all, which race shall we run for 
next year's Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm the one running it, it's got to 
be a G1! Asahi Hai FS? Maybe the Hanshin 
JF!

It's impossible for her to run in a G1 
race if she hasn't proven herself yet. If 
that's the case, what she should be 
running now is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's hear it!
choice_data_list:
Why don't you run the Keio Cup Junior 
Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmhm…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait, 1400 meters!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a little short to be aiming for 
the Satsuki Sho and other Classic races!?
choice_data_list:
The Junior class races are all short 
distances.

The Junior class races are all short 
distances.

text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I think even 1400m is too 
long for Sakura Bakushin O…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmmm…! For that matter――
choice_data_list:
As class president, you have to show your 
good faith.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm…!? Faith?

It's cool to jump into a G1 race out of 
nowhere, but some people may be so 
surprised by Sakura Bakushin O's speed 
that they'll collapse.

So, I explained to her that she would 
first show her face in the Keio Haiyu 
Junior Stakes and then gradually let her 
speed be known…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's absolutely true―!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In my next target race, I'm 
going to bring my speed to the world!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, let's get you used to hearing people 
say "too fast"!

At any rate, this is how I decided our 
next target would be the Keio Haiyu Junior 
S.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BakushinBakushiiiin!
